method: Every route below executes actual authored choices, safe observations and D20 outcomes through the production engine. Party size is fixed at one or four; maximum combat routes use natural 20 player rolls and natural 1 enemy rolls to witness reachability, not simulate typical balance. Zero-combat routes use the automatic bypass at each encountered gate. Every witness reaches an ordinary ending; no scene is teleported or victory fabricated. Dedicated tests also cover all 45 individual encounters, each grade, 1–4 scaling, deaths, resurrection, save migration and four real online clients.
